call_points.text: FY27 EBITDA growth guided at 17-20% and PAT growth at 12-15%, better than earlier forecast.
EBITDA margin 34.2% including Ascent versus 39.4% excluding it; cost savings visible from Q2.
About ₹40 crore of deals signed last quarter, to be recognised over 3 to 15 months.
Six new fund manager mandates above US$100 million won at Ascent, transitions from incumbents.
Cash of ₹687 crore at end-June; about ₹200 crore to go towards the declared dividend.
Corporate actions, about 30% of issuer solutions revenue, may stay tepid in Q2 on IT services dividend cuts.
Philippines pension contract not awarded; company was reported highest bidder, still in discussions.
EBITDA margin for FY26 was maintained at 40.7% including Ascent.

guidance.statement: We expect to get to about 24% to 25% top line growth into the coming year.
EBITDA we expect it to be around 16% to 17% growth into the coming year.
EBITDA margin in the range of 40-45%, maintaining 40% threshold including Ascent by end of this year
Ascent to reach double-digit EBITDA margin within the next 12 months
International business to continue growing over 25%

industry: Financial Services > Capital Markets > Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries

operating_notes.text: International business accounts for nearly 20% of the overall revenue mix.
Non-domestic mutual fund revenue share in overall revenue improved to 38.6% y-o-y.
Overall AUM grew 381.5% y-o-y to US$45.7 billion; international clients increased to 499.
International organic revenue is expected to grow over 60% in FY27.
Launched AEGIX, an AI-native integrated investor relations intelligence platform for listed companies.
Mutual fund fee-based revenue fell to 55% of total revenue in Q1FY27 from about 66% in Q1FY26, while non-MF revenue rose to 38% from 24.5%.
Ascent revenue rose to US$5.9 million in Q1FY27 from US$5.7 million in Q4 and US$4.4 million in Q1FY26, a 32% YoY increase.
Corporate actions are about 30% of issuer solutions revenue; KFin managed about 80% by market cap of main board IPOs in Q1 and holds 50% share of NSE 500 companies.
International clients reached 515 with AAUM at US$51.9 billion.
KFin Technologies (Thailand) Limited received its Foreign Business License from the Department of Business Development, Ministry of Commerce, Thailand.
